host.title: Host
host.description: UniFi Network host. Include the port for a self-hosted server, for example 192.168.1.10:8443.

username.title: Username
username.description: Local UniFi account used by the plugin.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password for the local UniFi account.

sites.title: Sites
sites.description: Sites to search. Leave empty to use the default site.

includeIds.title: Include Device IDs
includeIds.description: Show only these UniFi device IDs. Leave empty to include every supported device.

excludeIds.title: Exclude Device IDs
excludeIds.description: Hide these UniFi device IDs. Exclusions take priority over inclusions.

refreshIntervalMinutes.title: Device Cache Refresh Interval (minutes)
refreshIntervalMinutes.description: How often the plugin refreshes its device list.
